description.text: The fourth and last expansion of the DPt series, released on 8 July 2009, in which the mythical Arceus made its card debut. It holds six Arceus, five in different types plus Arceus LV.X, which takes the type of the Arceus it levels up from. Every Arceus follows a special Arceus rule that lets a deck hold any number of them, and they have a holo treatment of their own. With the two Arceus LV.X Constructed Standard Decks, Arceus was covered in every type. The cards are numbered to 90. In English it became Arceus in November 2009.
